notes.title: New Mr. Mat Hematic in development! - We have some news!
notes.content:
We have some news!
We saw the game's potential, and we will act now! Mr. Mat Hematic: Definitive Edition (not the official title) is in development!

What's happening?
I always had this idea: If this game would gain positive feedback in its current state, I would improve everything (especially visuals and clunky movement) and release it as something like Mr. Mat Hematic: Definitive Edition.

I imagined this to happen a few years later, after a few games, but I think it is time!

We started the development of the new Mr. Mat Hematic! Currently, the new character looks like this:

https://i.imgur.com/p7qQJDE.png

What will I need from you?
Even after we have improved the visuals and movements, it is not enough to release it as a new game. We’ll need to add more levels, mechanics, cutscenes, etc. (maybe enemies, and a boss?).

We’ll need more time and budget to dedicate to this project. So we are planning to launch a Kickstarter campaign once we are ready. That’s why I am asking each of you to consider whether you’d like to support this project or not. If your answer is yes, please, subscribe to our mailing list, or join our Discord Server! :)

What is Kickstarter?

You can get more detailed information about the game on our website.

notes.title: What's next for Shahmuradov Games? - Our New Game!
notes.content:
2 weeks since the release!
It has been 2 weeks since the release of Mr. Mat Hematic and the results are amazing! Over 3 million impressions, nearly 2k players! You can find the detailed results on my YouTube video below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wGTW5IFR1DE&t=3
I want to thank all the players who have supported me in this journey. But as someone wise once said: it is not the end, it is only the beginning!

We have started working on our next game! We are not ready to reveal all the details yet, but it is planned to be a multiplayer game. If you are interested in staying updated on our games, you can check out our website and subscribe to our mailing list:

notes.title: 1 week since the release! - Mr. Mat Hematic
notes.content:
Data
1 week has passed since the release of Mr. Mat Hematic, my first Steam game, and here are the results:
Reviews: 20+ (Mostly Positive)
Unique players: 600+
Average daily active users: 80+
Impressions: 1M+
Visits: 20k+

Mentions in some websites: 
1) https://www.riotbits.com/mr-mat-hematic/
2) https://re-actor.net/mr-mat-hematic-how-to-find-secret-level-malades-miwqa-achievement/

Overall
I would also like to mention that this game started as a 1-week game jam hosted by GameDev.tv. So overall with no marketing budget and no intention of making this game big, I think this game was a decent experience for me as a first Steam release. I am already thinking of applying this new experience to my upcoming Steam projects. So stay tuned!

If you have any feedback or suggestions I would appreciate it in the comments. 🙂

notes.title: Mr. Mat Hematic - Released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=OyRwaF-SOJs;full][/previewyoutube]

Mr. Mat Hematic - Released!

It all started as a 1-week Game Jam entry in 2022. Now it has made its way through the Steam store as one of the unique 2D Puzzle Platformers. 

As a solo developer, I have spent so much time fixing unexpected bugs, and polishing as much as I can while also making interesting levels and mechanics. So please do not hesitate to write a review on the game's store page after playing the game, as it supports the game's visibility on Steam and I would be able to improve the game further. 

I want to make more games, so if you want to support me or stay updated you can follow or contact my socials for more information about my future projects.
